info.title: GLU Google Drive API
info.description: Custom connector used by GLU to create, rename and delete folders directly within Google Drive. This is required because the standard Power Automate Google Drive connector does not expose native Create Folder or Delete Folder operations.

post.description: Creates a folder underneath the supplied Google Drive parent folder.

parameters.description: Required when working with Shared Drives.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Fields to return from Google Drive.

delete.summary: Safely Delete a Folder from Google Drive
delete.description: Permanently deletes the supplied Google Drive folder.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Google Drive ID of the folder to delete.

parameters.description: Required when working with Shared Drives.
